proves.claim: clause 1: a received state going from verified or landed back to open holds each claimed dependent with a reason naming repo#id.

store.io-board-link-regress.reopened-hol.why: Without it a parent item could keep building on a prerequisite that its own board reopened.

proves.claim: clause 2: a dependent that already landed gets a notice fact and no hold.

store.io-board-link-regress.landed-depen.why: Without it a landed item would be held after the fact, or the person would never learn its prerequisite reopened.

proves.claim: clause 1: a first received state, and a state that only moves open to claimed, hold no dependent.

store.io-board-link-regress.first-state-.why: Without it every first announcement or ordinary progress would hold the items that wait on a child.

proves.claim: clause 1: a child item that went from landed back to open is a regression; a first state, an open to claimed move and an unchanged verified item are not.

store.io-board-link-regress.landed-state.why: Without it a landed prerequisite that reopens would not be noticed.

proves.claim: clause 1: a submitted dependent of a regressed child item gets a notice fact naming repo#id and no hold, while a claimed dependent is held.

store.io-board-link-regress.submitted-de.why: Without it a submitted dependent could be held by a move that refuses it, or the person would never learn its prerequisite reopened while the item sat in review.
